shifts.H1_new_material: Held-out dense packing in the same class as visible V2_dense_pack (low voidage, high particle density) with different numeric values.
shifts.H2_dispersion_regime: Held-out high-Pe / large-D_ax case in the same class as visible V3_dispersion_regime, with different velocity and dispersion values.
shifts.H3_sensor_faults: Held-out mid-bed dropout/spike faults in the same class as visible V4_sensor_faults; outlet remains the primary identification signal.
shifts.H4_high_cin: Held-out elevated feed concentrations in the same class as visible V5_high_cin (near-saturation Langmuir curvature).
shifts.H5_near_linear: Held-out near-linear isotherm (small K) in the same class as visible V6_near_linear, with different service-window numbers.
